examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Baseline range picker with Start/End time fields and a timezone selector (defaults to the user local zone; set `timezone` to pin a specific IANA zone).

examples.name: Open
examples.summary: The popover pinned open, so the surfaces inside it are documented and visually compared: the Start/End date + time fields (each bound to its visible label), the month strip with its static header, the timezone selector, and the Apply/Clear footer. Every field here follows the same contract as a standalone `input` — same heights, same `.text-label-sm` value, same hover and disabled treatment.

examples.name: Single
examples.summary: Single-date mode picks one day instead of a range.

examples.name: Horizontal
examples.summary: Horizontal layout places the Start/End fields and Apply beside the calendar, with a full-height divider.

examples.name: WithPresets
examples.summary: Consumer presets drive the two-part trigger: the left dropdown applies a range in one click; the right calendar fine-tunes it. The presets count back from a fixed reference day, so server and browser render the same range.

examples.name: MinMax
examples.summary: The `min` and `max` bounds (±2 months) around a fixed reference day disable days outside the allowed window and clamp navigation.

examples.name: WithTime
examples.summary: Start/End time fields round-trip the hours and minutes of each endpoint.

examples.name: WithTimezone
examples.summary: A timezone selector (IANA zones) labels the selection; defaults to the local zone.

examples.name: SelectPeriod
examples.summary: Select Period mode: pick a relative span (`45m`, `last month`) and the trigger shows the token beside the resolved window (`14:44 – 23:59`).

examples.name: Clearable
examples.summary: A clear control on the trigger empties the committed selection when present.
